cardStatus: done within documented heuristic coverage and demonstrable Unicode checks
implemented: Shared per-page assessment examines trustworthy Unicode/geometry and significant image regions, rather than requiring a large native character count
Short purely native pages skip OCR; native header/footer bands do not mark an entire scanned body as covered
Unicode replacement/private/unassigned/control mappings identify broken page fonts; extraction filters those fonts before line grouping, so valid added OCR on the same line remains readable
Reader selection/reflow, EPUB reflow, structured DOCX, searchable PDF and selected table regions supplement uncovered content while retaining trustworthy native text
De-duplication requires matching normalized text and geometry; complete word geometry permits removal of the overlapping native word while retaining other words
Reader caches include policy/engine options; comparison, workflow and library indexing signatures include changed text policy
Searchable PDF emits a durable per-page reason/native/bad-glyph/image/addition report and human-readable completion totals
Search, plain text extraction and native table text use the same trustworthy-font filter; original page content is retained

cases: short native page needs zero OCR calls
image contains native header and footer with over 60 characters but still requires body OCR
same OCR line has a native HEADER and separately retained MISSING word
real authored ToUnicode private-use mapping triggers OCR fallback
reader and text export can read the repaired layer despite the old layer sharing the page

limits: The OCR layouts in the concentrated check are supplied fixtures; this measures coverage/extraction/de-duplication, not model recognition accuracy
Significant-image and vertical-band coverage is heuristic; photographs or sparse searchable scans may receive one supplemental OCR pass
Printable but semantically wrong Unicode cannot be identified reliably by these checks
Original damaged Unicode maps remain physically present in derived PDFs to preserve source content; other readers may still expose them, while PaperForge filters the affected page font
Partial OCR without complete word geometry retains the complete unmatched line, prioritizing content retention over speculative deletion
Library index/EPUB/DOCX/table integrations compile and share the policy; their old broad suites were not repeated
UI verification is grouped with the upcoming adaptive UI work; emulator processes reset when the user continued
No new version, tag or release
